heading.measuredLongestRealInstance: "A profile that feels like you, because it is" = 8 words
heading.note: Contains a non-breaking space after the leading 'A' in the source.

illustration.note: Illo-Sitter-and-Kid.webp, max-width 70% with margin-bottom -56px so it overhangs the row

constraints.exactlyThreeCards: The original renders exactly 3, numbered 1-3. Not a repeatable list.

motion.appliesTo: the .section-header.cc-tabas-header block only (the eyebrow + heading), not the cards
motion.note: This is the ONLY scroll reveal on the entire marketing site. /parents and /sitters carry the same class but have no data-w-id and no inline opacity:0 — do NOT add a reveal there.

responsive.desktop: Row A is .row.row-reverse (align-items:flex-end) putting the illustration right of the header. Row B is .row.how-it-works, 3-up, cards 373.3x408.
responsive.le991: Row A becomes column-reverse wrap; illustration max-width 100%. Row B becomes flex-direction:column -> cards 1-up, min-height auto.
responsive.le767: Row A becomes a plain column with align-items:flex-start; illustration max-width 70%, margin-bottom -40px, margin-left -40px.
